move.definition: To change position or location in space

cooperate.definition: To work together for mutual benefit

compete.definition: To strive against others for resources or advantage

rest.definition: To cease activity and recover energy

isolate.definition: To separate from others and become independent

thrive.definition: To prosper and flourish with high fitness

struggle.definition: To face difficulty and low fitness

stable.definition: To maintain consistent state without major change

social.definition: To be connected and integrated with others

isolated.definition: To be separated and disconnected from others

rich.definition: To have abundant resources and wealth

poor.definition: To have scarce resources and deprivation

weak.definition: Having low fitness and limited capability

fast.definition: Moving or acting with high speed

slow.definition: Moving or acting with low speed

together.definition: In association or cooperation with others

share.definition: To distribute resources or information with others

before.definition: Earlier in time, in the past

after.definition: Later in time, in the future

center.definition: At the central position or core

crowded.definition: High density of organisms or entities

think.definition: To use mental processes and reasoning

learn.definition: To acquire knowledge or skill through experience

remember.definition: To recall or retain information from the past

evolve.definition: To develop and change over time

expand.definition: To grow or increase in size

discover.definition: To find or learn something new
